This topic is part of the OCR A-Level English Language specification.

Paper 2: Dimensions of Linguistic Variation appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Paper 2: Dimensions of Linguistic Variation in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The OCR board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Paper 2: Dimensions of Linguistic Variation.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
